scope: Existing canonical Poaceae only. POWO/WCVP names, authorship, synonymy, infraspecific boundaries, and identity/hybrid cautions; no species, photo, genus, county, Pages or installer edits.

selected_heterotypic_synonyms: Bromus depauperatus H.Scholz (nom. illeg., later homonym)
taxa.key_conflict: POWO accepts Bromus lanceolatus with 44 listed synonyms, but certain historical subspecies combinations under B. lanceolatus belong to other accepted species. Do not flatten all old B. lanceolatus subspecies records to this learner card; preserve rank, authorship and specimen source concept.
taxa.identity_hold: HOLD_SOURCE_PHOTO_IDENTITY_PROVISIONAL; the existing single photograph has not been independently verified to distinguish historical segregates. Taxonomy acceptance does not certify image ID.
taxa.hybrid_review: No hybrid formula or independent hybrid identity established; any pre-existing hybrid HOLD remains unchanged.
taxa.action: Retain existing accepted species; record historic aliases and segregate cautions in taxonomy evidence only.

taxa.key_conflict: Historic Bromus purgans varieties and forms are NOT a single modern species: B. purgans var. texensis is homotypic with accepted B. texensis, but B. purgans var. laeviglumis maps to B. pubescens and B. purgans var. ciliatus maps to B. ciliatus. Do not collapse all 'B. purgans' source names to Texas brome or woodland brome without rank and author.
primary_authorities: Shear, C.L. (1900). Bromus purgans var. texensis, Bull. U.S.D.A. 23: 41.
Hitchcock, A.S. (1913). Bromus texensis combination, Contributions from the United States National Herbarium 17: 381.
Wagnon, H.K. (1952). A revision of the genus Bromus, section Bromopsis, of North America. Brittonia 7: 415-480. DOI:10.2307/2804968.
Saarela, J.M., Peterson, P.M. & Valdés-Reyna, J. (2014). A taxonomic revision of Bromus in México and Central America. Phytotaxa 185(1):1-147.
taxa.identity_hold: HOLD_SOURCE_PHOTO_IDENTITY_PROVISIONAL; no independent mature spikelet/glume proof for existing gallery photograph. Historical type/region differences do not validate an individual image.
taxa.hybrid_review: No hybrid determination made; retain any existing scientific hybrid HOLD.
taxa.action: Retain separate B. texensis accepted species and preserve rank-qualified B. purgans var. texensis alias; no source-photo re-identification.

selected_homotypic_synonyms: Bromus hookeri var. pubescens (Spreng.) E.Fourn. (not validly published)

taxa.key_conflict: Historical combinations under Bromus purgans and Bromus ciliatus split across accepted B. pubescens, B. texensis and B. ciliatus. Author/rank are mandatory before mapping historical names; B. purgans var. texensis does not synonymize to B. pubescens.
taxa.identity_hold: HOLD_SOURCE_PHOTO_IDENTITY_PROVISIONAL; installed low-resolution photo cannot independently verify mature lemma characters. Accepted name does not establish photo ID.
taxa.hybrid_review: No hybrid identity established; preserve all existing scientific HOLD/UNRESOLVED.
taxa.action: Retain distinct accepted B. pubescens; map rank-qualified historical aliases only in evidence; no canonical card changes.

cross_species_concept_guard: Bromus purgans var. texensis Shear -> B. texensis; B. purgans var. laeviglumis (Scribn. ex Shear) Swallen -> B. pubescens; B. purgans var. ciliatus (L.) Kuntze -> B. ciliatus. These are three accepted species; never use unqualified parent-name strings to merge them.
preserve_scientific_states: All existing PASS/FAIL/HOLD/UNRESOLVED and photo/source ID provenance preserved; no species-level name acceptance implies a voucher-verified photograph.
